maintenance_led.reason: Revenue is mainly recurring home medical supplies and equipment (diabetes, sleep, wound care, ostomy) delivered to patients, not repair or maintenance of installed assets.

publicly_funded.reason: Apria and Byram bill mostly commercial insurers plus Medicare/Medicaid; government is not clearly the majority payer.

serial_acquirer.reason: Growth comes mainly from its Apria and Byram home-care businesses; Apria was one large deal, not a steady roll-up.

mission_critical.reason: Patients depend on supplies, but payer networks and other home-care suppliers make switching feasible; moderate friction only.

notes: Accendra is the renamed Owens & Minor; its payer mix and the status of its former products segment are uncertain, so the answers are lower confidence.
